title: SensorData - request  (firmware -> POST /api/SensorData)
description: Body built by SensorController::buildSensorDataPayload(): a JSON ARRAY of readings. The firmware buffers unsent readings and flushes them together, so the array has one or more items. Each measurement field is sent as a JSON NUMBER since roadmap #326 (SensorData moved from Arduino String to double/NaN), null when that sensor produced no value this cycle - a STRING is still accepted for a device running pre-#326 firmware still in the field (ReadInt/ReadDouble in EfRepository.SensorData.cs parse either). The API forwards the array unchanged to the SensorDataPush stored procedure (JSON_TABLE). There is no response schema - the endpoint returns the caller's cached ConfigVersion as a bare value. Credentials travel as HTTP HEADERS: 'apiId' and 'Authorization' (apiAuth token).

soilTemperature.description: Firmware sends the key 'soilTemperature'. Note the DeviceModel.h SensorData field is named 'temperatureSoil' - the wire key does not match the struct field name.

rainLevel.description: Rain sensor reading. The SensorDataPush stored procedure reads it via JSON_TABLE PATH '$.rainLevel', which matches this key - it is stored, not dropped.

dateCreated.description: Firmware-side timestamp (device.getDateTime()) recorded when the reading was buffered; null when the clock is not yet set.
